body:
Suresh, aapne pucha tha "Yes good idea, what would it look like" — yeh raha first draft, edit kar sakte hain:
Mylari South Indian Cafe Corporate Lunch
• 10-24 thalis/day: ₹134 each (retail ₹149)
• 25-49: ₹126 each + free delivery
• 50+: ₹119 each + free delivery
• Order on WhatsApp by 11am, delivered by 1pm
Pre-ordered volume hai, isliye margin safe rehta hai. Ise one-page PDF + Indiranagar ke office admins ke liye 3-line WhatsApp pitch bana doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Merchant already expressed planning intent — skip qualifying, hand over a concrete editable draft (intent -> action) and one next step.

body: Hi Aditya, Karim's Salon, Alambagh here. Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow. Reply YES to confirm, or tell us if you need to reschedule.
rationale: Appointment reminder: confirm-or-reschedule reduces no-shows; honours customer language.

body: Hi Riya, Beauty Lounge by Renu, Gomti Nagar se. Reminder: aapka appointment kal hai. Aapka visit #3 — hamesha accha lagta hai. Confirm karne ke liye YES reply karein, ya reschedule chahiye toh bata dijiye.
rationale: Appointment reminder: confirm-or-reschedule reduces no-shows; honours customer language.

body: Ramesh, summer demand shift is here: ORS +40%, sunscreen +38%, antifungal +45%, cold cough -60%. Suggested shelf change: move ORS + sunscreen to counter visibility; cold/cough to back shelf. I can also send your repeat customers (68% of your base) a short 'Summer first-aid: what every Indian household should have' note. Draft kar doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Seasonal demand shift with exact category deltas; concrete shelf action + a ready customer-content broadcast.

body: Dr. Meera, IDA Delhi: Digital impressions — 2026 state of the art — Sat 2 May, 7pm. 2 CDE credits. Speaker: Dr. R. Mehta. Covers Primescan 2, Trios 5, and CAD/CAM workflow ROI for solo practices. Fee: Free for IDA members; ₹500 for non-members. Ek din pehle reminder set kar doon? Reply YES. — IDA Delhi chapter calendar
rationale: Free/low-cost CDE event relevant to practice tech; low-stakes reminder CTA respects the doctor's time.

body: Namaste — Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy, Malviya Nagar se. Sharma ji ki 3 niyamit dawaiyan (metformin, atorvastatin, telmisartan) 28 Apr ko khatam ho jayengi. Laagu: Free Home Delivery > ₹499; Senior Citizen 15% OFF. Saved address pe delivery kar denge. Wahi parchi dispatch karne ke liye CONFIRM likhein, ya dose badla ho toh bata dijiye.
rationale: Chronic refill: exact molecules + run-out date, only offers the merchant actually runs, respectful senior/family addressing, dose-change safety check.

body: Hi Vivaan, Bright Smile Dental, Indiranagar here. Your routine check-up + cleaning is due (last visit 1 Apr). Reply YES and we'll book a slot that suits you this week.
rationale: Follow-up due for a non-pharmacy customer: framed as a routine visit (no prescription claims), relationship-grounded, single CTA.

body: Dr. Meera, Smile Studio opened 1.3 km from you on 8 Apr, leading with Dental Cleaning @ ₹199 vs your Dental Cleaning @ ₹299. Your edge isn't price: 5 reviews this month praise doctor manner ("Dr. Meera explains everything patiently"). Price war ki zaroorat nahi — jo customers already aapke baare mein bolte hain, usi pe ek GBP post draft kar doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Competitor event framed as loss-aversion, but steers away from a price war toward the merchant's real differentiator (reviews/offer).

body: Suresh, a new restaurant listing has come up near Indiranagar on Google. Your baseline: 12,400 views and 88 calls in 30 days; your CTR is 3.2%, above the 2.5% peer average. Your edge isn't price: 22 reviews this month praise thali quality. Easiest defence is a sharp, visible offer — Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 (already live). Is hafte listing refresh kar doon taaki aap hi first pick rahein? Reply YES.
rationale: Competitor event framed as loss-aversion, but steers away from a price war toward the merchant's real differentiator (reviews/offer).

body: Lakshmi, quick sawaal — is hafte Studio11 Family Salon mein sabse zyada kaunsi service maangi gayi? Bas naam reply kar dijiye — main usse Google post + WhatsApp enquiries ke liye ready price-reply bana dungi.

body: Hi Rashmi, Karthik from PowerHouse Fitness here. It's been 57 days — breaks happen, no judgment. Your weight loss plan from your 5 months with us is still on file, so you won't start from zero. Current offer: 3 FREE Trial Classes. Want us to hold a weekday evening slot this week? Reply YES — no commitment.
rationale: Lapsed customer win-back: no-shame tone, references their past goal, merchant's real offer, zero-commitment YES.

body: Hi Reyansh, main Komal, Daily Care Medicos se. Aapka last visit 1 Apr ko tha — ab tak ke 12 visits ke liye shukriya. Regular medicines ka sahi time hai. Reply YES — aapki usual medicines pickup ya home delivery ke liye ready rakhenge.
rationale: Lapsed customer win-back: no-shame tone, references their past goal, merchant's real offer, zero-commitment YES.

body: Anjali, koi pitch nahi — bas yeh batana tha ki plan pause hone ke 38 din mein kya badla: calls -30% this week; 180 customers now lapsed in total. A 'Haircut @ ₹99' comeback message to those lapsed customers is the quickest win. Draft kar doon? Reply YES — renew karne ki koi commitment nahi.
rationale: Win-back: reciprocity-first (value before ask), quantified loss since expiry, zero-commitment CTA.

body: Anand, kaafi time ho gaya. Quick pulse on Chai Point Cafe: 2,189 views in 30 days, calls -21% this week; your CTR is 2.5%, right at the peer average. Kya chal raha hai aur ek cheez jo main fix karungi — 3 line mein bhej doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Dormant merchant: re-open with a curiosity hook built on their own numbers, no hard sell.

body: Lakshmi, Diwali is on 31 Oct 2026 — 188 days out. Category pattern for Oct-Dec: primary wedding/festival season — bridal package bookings 4x baseline. Prime slots fill first, so early movers win the calendar. Your Haircut @ ₹99 is a natural festive hook. Ek early-bird festive post draft kar doon jo aap abhi approve karke baad mein schedule kar sakein? Reply YES.
rationale: Festival trigger anchored on date + category seasonality; early-bird framing with the merchant's own offer.

rationale: Festival trigger anchored on date + category seasonality; early-bird framing with the merchant's own offer.

body: Vikas, Sunrise Medicos's Google profile is still unverified. Verified listings typically see ~30% more visibility — on your 720 monthly views that's roughly 216 more. Verification is via postcard or a phone call; I'll walk you through it in about 5 minutes. Abhi start karein? Reply YES.
rationale: Unverified GBP: quantified upside on the merchant's own views; effort externalised to a 5-minute guided step.

body: Suresh, DC vs MI at Arun Jaitley Stadium tonight, 7:30pm. Dine-in promo pe kharcha karne se pehle — weekend-match data: Saturday IPL matches shift orders to home-watch parties; restaurant covers down 12% vs Saturday average (magicpin order data, Apr 2026). Your 'Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free (Tue-Thu)' doesn't cover Sunday, so skip the dine-in push. Tonight is a delivery night: people watch at home. A delivery-only Match-night Combo @ ₹399 (food + drink) fits exactly. Tonight-only offer bana ke listing pe live kar doon? Reply YES — toss se pehle live.
rationale: Weekend match: digest says Saturday IPL shifts demand to home-watching, so recommend delivery over dine-in (contrarian, data-backed).

body: Suresh, Mylari South Indian Cafe is at 145 reviews — just 5 away from 150. 22 reviews this month praise your thali quality. Counter ke liye ek chhota QR review card bana doon taaki happy customers review de sakein? Reply YES.
rationale: Milestone proximity creates a goal-gradient pull; low-effort artifact (QR card) converts existing happy customers.

body: Dr. Bharat, your calls are down 50% over the last 7 days (baseline 12). Aapki taraf se fixable: your Google profile is still unverified; no active offer (peers run 'Dental Cleaning @ ₹299'); CTR 1.8% vs 3% peer avg. Pehla fix aaj hi start kar doon? Reply YES.
rationale: calls dip 50% — loss aversion anchored on the merchant's own numbers, paired with concrete, fixable causes from their profile.

body: Sushma, quick check on your calls: the 7-day trend is actually flat (+2%), but at 22 in 30 days you're below the 28 peer average — that gap is the real opportunity. Aapki taraf se fixable: no active offer (peers run 'Haircut @ ₹99'). Pehla fix aaj hi start kar doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Dip trigger but 7-day calls is not negative — reported honestly and reframed around the peer gap + fixable profile issues.

body: Dr. Meera, compliance heads-up — deadline 15 Dec 2026 (232 days). DCI revised radiograph dose limits effective 2026-12-15. Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. Next step: audit your X-ray setup before Dec 15; document E-speed or RVG in your SOPs. Main ek 1-page SOP checklist draft kar doon jo aap sign karke file kar sakein? Reply YES. — Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04
rationale: Regulatory change with a hard deadline; cites source + exact thresholds, offers a done-for-you SOP (effort externalisation).
